attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 307780)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Mortal_Kombat_X
Fandom (mortalkombat.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://mortalkombat.fandom.com/wiki/Mortal_Kombat_X
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). The Steam schema calls app 307780 "Karloff" (an internal codename); the store list confirms it as "Mortal Kombat X". StrategyWiki has a page at completion stage 0: its Walkthrough and all 12 Story chapter pages ("Chapter 1: Johnny Cage" to "Chapter 12: Cassie Cage") are linked but not written; only Alien, Bo' Rai Cho, Cassie Cage, D'Vorah, Characters and Table of Contents are written (character move pages), so it was not used. mortalkombat.fandom.com answers the API under "Mortal Kombat X", with about 269 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 73 Steam achievements is hidden. "Kombat Pack 2" is the only pack name in the data; the Kombat Pack chapter groups achievements that name Leatherface, Triborg, Alien, Bo' Rai Cho, Robot Types or the Klassic Tower. "Hara Kiri" and "Disco" name Kotal Kahn and stay in the fighting chapter. "Win 1 Tower Battle" and "Complete 1 Tower Battle" are grouped with the towers by name only; they may be faction or online modes and need checking. Most achievements are below 10% on Steam.
